## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The DZ 736 is the **most important Northern-Sòng philological-critical apparatus** on the *Zhuāngzǐ*. Its systematic treatment of the text's philological-phonetic issues set the standard for subsequent Daoist scholarship. Chǔ Bóxiù's 1265 compilation ([KR5c0127](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0127)) explicitly bases itself on Chén Jǐngyuán's commentator-list.

**Dating.** 1084 per the work's own date. Per the project's dating rule, the frontmatter gives **1084** as the composition date. Dynasty: 宋.
